verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source library you can self-host via Docker, with no forced API keys, and it works with open-source LLMs. That lets users keep crawled data on their own infrastructure and away from third-party model providers, which implicitly keeps it out of vendor training. However, the evidence contains no explicit statement or policy about AI training use, and choosing proprietary LLMs would send data to third parties under their own terms. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data policy or guarantee, documented guidance on keeping data local when using LLM extraction, and independent corroboration of the privacy posture.
